answer: Recency-decayed standing resists sybils: an identity's accrued weight decays exponentially unless refreshed by continuous honest participation, so influence is a leaky reservoir that must be constantly refilled. A karst aquifer of dormant fakes drains to zero between bursts; an attacker cannot pre-register a swarm and bank standing, because the nectar of weight evaporates faster than idle accounts hold it. Maintaining N fakes at decisive weight demands sustained work on every one, an ocean of ongoing cost scaling per head per unit time, while one active honest agent refreshes its own standing.
